name: gridstory
description: A framework-neutral, React-first content management system.

scripts.database:backup: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node apps/api/dist/recovery-cli.js backup
scripts.database:restore: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node apps/api/dist/recovery-cli.js restore
scripts.database:verify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node apps/api/dist/recovery-cli.js verify
scripts.rollout:check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node apps/api/dist/rolling-upgrade-cli.js
scripts.benchmark:sqlite: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node scripts/benchmark-release.mjs --profile sqlite
scripts.benchmark:postgres: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/api build && node scripts/benchmark-release.mjs --profile postgres
scripts.schema:generate: pnpm build:packages && node scripts/generate-schema-types.mjs --write && pnpm --filter @gridstory/example-kit build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm schema:check && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint: biome lint . && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-ledgers.mjs && node scripts/check-security-model.mjs && node scripts/check-tenant-scope.mjs && node scripts/check-release-readiness.mjs --self-test --review release/readiness/review-2026-08-21-b31193a.json
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm build:e2e && playwright test --project=chromium && playwright test --project=firefox && playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.test:compatibility: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridstory/react test:run && pnpm --filter @gridstory/compat-react18-vite --filter @gridstory/example-vite run build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:run && pnpm build
